name: Anthemis
thesis: The most active insurance-specialist VC. Led the seed of the closest emerging-market parametric precedent, and its new insurance fund is anchored by Japanese insurance money.

warm: Sumitomo Life is an LP — the same group as the Sumitomo Insurance conversation, if that MoU sits with Sumitomo Life rather than Mitsui Sumitomo.

name: Convective Capital
thesis: The only fund whose stated thesis is disaster resilience as an investable class — flood, storm, grid, wildfire — with insurers as LPs. The protection deck is written in their language.
evidence: $85M Fund II closed May 2026; ~18 investments planned across pre-seed, seed and Series A; LPs include two insurers, several foundations and a pension fund. Fund I: 79% of companies graduated seed → A.
warm: Cold. The Sri Lanka mission is the opener.

evidence: Descartes Underwriting Series B (Jan 2022); Raincoat extended seed (Jun 2023); 82 companies. $100M LatAm Fund I closed 2026, anchored by IDB Invest and COFIDES. No new deals disclosed yet in 2026.
precedents: Descartes Underwriting, Raincoat, Bolttech, Shift, Wefox
